title: Plays per month
statementMd:
Number of plays per month (YYYY-MM).

Expected columns: `month`, `plays`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', played_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM plays GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
```
